_doc: TCB manifest for the proof-carrying pipeline (Trust = Clean fusion): the named, explicit trust base every emitted certificate rests on. Batteries-included — the cert path attests these rows by DEFAULT (no opt-in flag). Each row records the assumption, its current status, its grounding, the residual TCB it still implies, and the discharge path that would retire it. Integrates the R_float ⊑ R_real adequacy binding (P1.3) as a machine-tracked row rather than prose. Drift-guarded against SPEC.md by ny_cert::tcb_check.

rows.claim: R_float ⊑ R_real — the f32 producer's bound is sound w.r.t. exact reals
rows.grounding: f32_to_rat (certify_onnx.rs:225) lifts every f32 losslessly to n/2^k (0 round-trip failures in 100k); all CROWN/relaxation math then runs in exact Rat → R_float = R_real exactly for emitted certs. No float in the cert path.
rows.residual_tcb: the fast preact_bounds_crown_snapped f64 path (crown_deep.rs:551) — demoted to cut-DISCOVERY-only (crown_deep.rs:790-799), falls back to exact-rational for the verdict; plus the non-cert ny-propagate verifier. CORRECTION (2026-06-29): the non-cert verifier's float soundness is NOT captured by directed outward rounding (dn/up) ALONE — that model assumes correctly-outward-rounded ops and is structurally blind to TRANSCENDENTAL underflow. A reachable FALSE PROOF was found+fixed in ny-propagate softmax IBP: a shared row-max shift made exp(score-M) underflow to exactly 0.0 (correct IEEE-754) and +SOFTMAX_EPSILON swamped the survivors, so a reachable key's p_hi collapsed to ~0 and the bound EXCLUDED a reachable true softmax of 1.0. Fixed via a per-ratio shift (dominant term = exp(0)=1, no underflow, no epsilon).
rows.discharge_path: FloatAdequacy.lean per-op lemmas (interval_outward_contains, affine_lower/upper_adequate, box_adequate, relu_chord_upper_adequate, float_bound_implies_real) de-TCB the directed-rounding (affine/box/ReLU) residual. For TRANSCENDENTAL ops the rounding model is insufficient: SoftmaxFloatRange.lean (added 2026-06-29) models finite-precision exp as an UNDER-ESTIMATING operator FExp (named float TCB: nonneg, le_exp : f x ≤ exp x, at_zero : f 0 = 1 — hypotheses, not axioms) and PROVES softmax_phi_upper_sound (the per-ratio-shift fix is a sound over-approximation, general n) while softmax_phi_shared_unsound CONSTRUCTIVELY REFUTES the old shared-shift form (flush-to-zero FExp + a >745-gap witness → computed 0 < true 1). VALIDATED 2026-06-29: lake build NyProof.SoftmaxFloatRange clean (1904 jobs); #print axioms (both theorems) = [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound] (no sorry; the FExp facts are structure fields). NyProof.FloatAdequacy still: lake clean vs Mathlib v4.30.0, integrated on main ca74984. NOT needed for emitted-cert soundness (exact path); these de-TCB the residual fast/non-cert float paths.
